Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.

Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

cosy — warm and comfortable. Example: The living room is cosy.
comfortable — pleasant to sit in or use. Example: The sofa is very comfortable.
warm — a little hot, in a pleasant way. Example: The lamp gives a warm light.
lamp — a light you can switch on. Example: There is a lamp near the window.
cushion — a soft bag you put on a chair. Example: The cushion is on the sofa.
sofa — a long soft seat for two or more people. Example: We sit on the sofa.
rug — a small carpet. Example: There is a rug on the floor.
curtain — cloth that covers a window. Example: The curtains are light blue.
light — not dark, or the thing that makes a room bright. Example: The room is light and warm.
decorate — to make a room look nicer. Example: We decorate the room in spring.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The room is cosy.
• It is very comfortable.
• I like the lamp.
• The curtains are light.
• Let's decorate it.

Grammar focus: Be + adjective.
Use be + adjective to describe a room: The room is cosy. The sofa is comfortable. The curtains are light.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct sentence.
Which word means 'pleasant to sit in'?
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
My living room is small but cosy. There is a big sofa and a soft rug. A warm lamp is near the window and the curtains are light.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Your room is very cosy. B: Thank you. The lamp is warm and the sofa is comfortable. A: I love the rug.
